biography.value: Kestrel Company cleric — stayed behind with Aldous; taken alive and turned. Lore: @UUID[JournalEntry.vSP2ywLNw9p5YsQL]{05 The Hollow — GM Key}.

description.value: A bronze brooch worked in the shape of a kestrel stooping to the dive — the badge of the Kestrel Company. This one's clasp was mended once with a twist of copper wire, a field repair done with care. It is still fastened at the throat of the thing that used to wear it.

You point at one creature you can see within range, and the single chime of a dolorous bell is audible within 10 feet of the target. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take 1d8 Necrotic damage. If the target is missing any of its Hit Points, it instead takes 1d12 Necrotic damage.

Cantrip Upgrade. The damage increases by one die when you reach levels 5 (2d8 or 2d12), 11 (3d8 or 3d12), and 17 (4d8 or 4d12).

affects.special: creature missing any of its Hit Points

description.value:
Edda casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC [[lookup @attributes.spell.dc]]):

At Will: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplTolltheDea]{Toll the Dead}

1/Day Each: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplBane000000]{Bane}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplBlindnessD]{Blindness/Deafness}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplCommand000]{Command}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplHoldPerson]{Hold Person}

Shard-Fed.

Six months dead. The Graveheart has barely begun on Edda — what she brought down here with her, she brought herself. The prayers still work. Nobody has told her they are answered by something else now.

Proficiency bonus +2 (all attacks, saves she forces, and skills). Life Drain DC 13.
